instruction: Show how to set the font size of the third paragraph in this document to 16 points.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

Custom getter extracts font size from the third paragraph, and custom metric compares against expected size with tolerance.
